name: aforge
description: 114 tools covering shell, filesystem, git, docker, browser, vault, postgres, github, and more. Governed execution — never self-authorizing.

scenarios.description: Agent reads a file and reports correct content. Verifies output matches expected.
scenarios.prompt: Read the file /etc/hostname and report its exact contents. If unavailable, report what you can determine about this system's hostname.

scenarios.description: Agent runs a shell command and returns correct output.
scenarios.prompt: Run `uname -a` and report the kernel version and architecture.

scenarios.description: Agent checks git status and reports correctly.
scenarios.prompt: Check the git status of /root/A-FORGE. Report the current branch, whether the working tree is clean, and the last commit message.
